finance.note.close_insurance_soft: The policy is cancelled (valid until today) and the premium is ended. Past bookings are kept.
finance.note.close_insurance_hard: WARNING: There are no bookings yet – the policy and its premium are deleted completely.
finance.note.close_pension_soft: The pension is paused and the monthly contribution is ended. Past bookings are kept.
finance.note.close_pension_hard: WARNING: There are no bookings yet – the pension and any linked contribution are deleted completely.
finance.note.close_goal_reserve_left: WARNING: There is still reserve left. Only confirm as completed if the money has already been spent – otherwise the closing is rejected (unless explicitly confirmed despite the remaining amount).
finance.note.close_goal_done: Action: close as completed (reserve used up). The booking history is kept.
finance.note.close_goal_cancel: Action: cancel — the goal is cancelled, the savings instalment is ended and the allocations are released (bookings stay as history). The balance is not touched.
finance.note.close_goal_delete: WARNING: There are no bookings yet – the goal, its reserve allocation and the savings instalment are deleted. Account balances are not touched.
finance.note.close_plan_soft: The regular execution is ended (valid until today) and the plan is paused. Past bookings are kept.
finance.note.close_plan_hard: WARNING: There are no bookings yet – the plan and its regular payment are deleted completely.
finance.note.import_all_or_nothing: All or nothing: if there are errors, NOTHING is booked.

finance.note.delete_account_referenced: WARNING: The account is still referenced {count} times (bookings/loans/custody accounts/standing orders) → deletion will be rejected. Close an active account instead.
finance.note.delete_account_hard: WARNING: The empty account is deleted completely.
finance.note.delete_holding_rejected: WARNING: This holding has trades → deletion will be rejected (reverse the trades first).
finance.note.delete_holding_hard: WARNING: The (empty) position is deleted. Past bookings are kept.
finance.note.delete_loan_rejected: WARNING: Instalments have already been booked → deletion will be rejected. To pay it off, settle the loan; to refinance, change the loan status to refinanced.
finance.note.delete_loan_hard: WARNING: The loan is removed completely – including its loan account, opening bookings and instalment. Current and payout accounts are kept.
finance.note.delete_re_rejected: WARNING: This property is linked to loans → deletion will be rejected (pay off or unlink the loans first).
finance.note.delete_re_hard: WARNING: The property is deleted completely.
finance.note.delete_rp_owned: WARNING: This standing order belongs to an entity (insurance/loan/retirement provision/savings goal/savings plan) → deletion will be rejected. Change or end it on the linked entity.
finance.note.delete_rp_booked: WARNING: There are booked occurrences → deletion will be rejected (reverse the bookings first).
finance.note.delete_rp_hard: WARNING: The standing order is deleted completely.

finance.dialog.book_failed: {name} could not be booked. Ask me in the chat about the current status.
finance.dialog.remind_tomorrow: I'll remind you about {name} again tomorrow.
finance.dialog.interest_ask:
Book the interest credit of {amount} to {account} for the period up to {period_end} (credited on {value_date})?

Different amount? Tap “No, different” and send me the correct amount.
finance.dialog.interest_defer: The interest credit for {account} is still open. Remind you again tomorrow or skip it for this period?
finance.dialog.monthly_check_intro: 📄 Monthly check: please send me the bank statement up to {date} for these accounts:
finance.dialog.monthly_check_howto:
How it works:
1. Open your online banking or banking app.
2. Under mailbox / documents, save the latest account statement as a PDF.
3. Send the PDF here in the chat – one statement per account, the next one only after you have confirmed the card.
I tick off your regular payments, book the rest as everyday spending and then tell you whether the money lasts until the next income.
finance.dialog.pension_statement_intro: 🧓 Pension check: these retirement provisions are missing a current pension statement:
finance.dialog.pension_statement_howto:
How it works:
1. Find the latest pension statement (Renteninformation / Standmitteilung) – for the statutory pension in the DRV mailbox (online services of the Deutsche Rentenversicherung) or in your letterbox.
2. Send the PDF or a photo here in the chat.
I read the figures (claim, projection, both scenarios, disability pension) and, once you confirm, save them with their date – so you can see how they develop over the years.

finance.dialog.price_gap_maybe: Possible match: {symbol} ({listing}, {price}) – but its price does not fit your previous price or purchase price, so I am not suggesting it.

finance.advisor.savings_pace: Savings goal “{name}”: {drift} percentage points behind plan (currently {progress} %, expected {expected} %).
finance.advisor.savings_pace_basis: “Expected” means steady progress from when the goal was created to its target date; it is reported from {tolerance} percentage points behind.
finance.advisor.savings_pace_catchup: Required catch-up rate: {rate} per month to keep the target date.
finance.advisor.savings_pace_projected: At the current pace it will be reached around {date}.
finance.advisor.goal_reached: Savings goal “{name}” reached ({saved} of {target}). Options: close it (use the reserve first), secure the gains, or raise the target. Note: the amount stays reserved until you use it – reached is not spent.
finance.advisor.goal_exceeded: Savings goal “{name}” reached and exceeded ({saved} of {target}). Options: close it (use the reserve first), secure the gains, or raise the target. Note: the amount stays reserved until you use it – reached is not spent.
finance.advisor.emergency_reserve: Emergency reserve short: {cash} of {target} is earmarked ({gap} missing).
finance.advisor.emergency_reserve_basis: Target: {months} months of expenses at {monthly} (fixed payments, loan instalments and estimated everyday spending).
finance.advisor.reserve_coverage: Reserve shortfall: the balance no longer covers the money set aside for savings goals (accounts: {accounts}).
finance.advisor.reserve_coverage_levers: Levers: reprioritise, extend a target date, raise the catch-up rate, or move the reserve.
finance.advisor.goal_derisk: Savings goal “{name}” (due {date}): {depot} of the goal money is still in the depot. So that a market drop shortly before the goal does no harm, all of it should move to an account step by step until the target date; today at most {allowed} in the depot makes sense. Suggestion: sell about {excess} now and keep it on an account for the goal.
finance.advisor.goal_derisk_plan: A savings plan keeps buying into the depot for this goal – pause it or redirect the instalment to an account.
finance.advisor.goal_derisk_tax: When selling, the Abgeltungssteuer on realised gains reduces the amount secured; book the sale with the bookkeeper and name the goal, so the proceeds stay assigned to it.
finance.advisor.goal_derisk_basis: The rule behind it: during the last {window} months before the target date the sensible depot share falls evenly to zero.
finance.advisor.depot_reserve: Depot reserve short: {reserved} is reserved against the depot “{account}” for “{goals}”, but its market value is only {market} (gap {gap}), and the current savings rate will not close it in time. Levers: top up, lower the reserve, extend the target date, raise the rate, or secure gains (sell depot → cash; note: the Abgeltungssteuer on realised gains reduces the amount actually secured).
finance.advisor.depot_reserve_fx_missing: IMPORTANT: the market value of this depot can NOT be determined right now (live price or exchange rate missing) – coverage cannot be determined reliably, so this is NOT yet a confirmed shortfall. Add the price/exchange rate, then check again.
finance.advisor.depot_reserve_fx_note: Note: the depot holds foreign-currency positions – the EUR coverage also moves with the exchange rate.
finance.advisor.plan_stale: Financial plan not confirmed for {days} days (threshold {threshold} days).
finance.advisor.tax_year: New tax year: check the Basiszins/Vorabpauschale and your Freistellungsauftrag (the Basiszins changes every year → otherwise the Vorabpauschale debit in January can needlessly exceed your allowance). Plan last confirmed in {year}.
finance.advisor.risk_profile_stale: Risk profile not confirmed for {days} days (threshold {threshold} days) – briefly check risk appetite and capacity.
finance.advisor.account_coverage: Account running low: “{account}” is projected to drop to {min} on {date}, below your buffer of {buffer}. The outlook uses the planned payments until the next incoming money and your everyday spending estimated from the bank statements (≈ {per_day} per day).
finance.advisor.account_coverage_provisi: The everyday estimate is provisional: there is only one bank statement so far, usually from before your standing orders were recorded, so it tends to be too high.
finance.advisor.account_coverage_default: The buffer is the household default; you can change it for this account in the chat (e.g. “always keep 400 € on this account”).
finance.advisor.maintenance_reserve_low: Maintenance reserve “{property}”: {rate} a month is running, the lower bound per II. BV is {recommended} ({rate_m2} per m² and year, building {age} years old). You can change the rate in the chat.
finance.advisor.maintenance_reserve_miss: “{property}” has no maintenance reserve yet. Per II. BV at least {recommended} a month is recommended.
“{property}” has no maintenance reserve yet. With the living area and the year built I can work out the recommended monthly rate.
finance.advisor.recurring_missing: “{name}” ({amount}) did not leave the account twice in a row, last due on {date}. Cancelled or switched provider? Then end the recurring payment, otherwise please check.
finance.advisor.cashflow_deficit: Cashflow deficit: your running spending (fixed payments, loan instalments and estimated everyday spending, {obligations}) exceeds income ({income}) by {deficit} per month. Savings rates are not included. Levers: cut expenses, raise income or refinance a loan.
finance.advisor.cashflow_buffer: Thin cashflow buffer: after fixed payments, loan instalments and everyday spending only {free} per month stays free ({pct} % of income, target {target} %) – little room for saving or reserves. Levers: cut expenses or raise income.
finance.advisor.cashflow_basis_everyday: Calculated with fixed payments and loan instalments ({fixed}) plus estimated everyday spending ({everyday} per month from the bank statements of {accounts} accounts).
finance.advisor.cashflow_basis_everyday_: Calculated with fixed payments and loan instalments ({fixed}) plus estimated everyday spending ({everyday} per month from {accounts} accounts) – the estimate is still provisional (only one bank statement) and tends to be too high.
finance.advisor.cashflow_basis_no_everyd: Everyday spending (groceries, card) is not included yet because there is no bank statement – in reality less stays free.
finance.advisor.savings_squeeze: Over-saving: your savings rates ({saving}) are higher than what stays free after fixed payments, loan instalments and everyday spending ({free}) – your current account shrinks by {gap} per month. Levers: lower or pause a savings rate, cut expenses or raise income.
finance.advisor.cashflow_fx_gap: Note: an exchange rate is missing for at least one recurring payment – this figure is incomplete.
finance.advisor.savings_goal_unmeasurabl: Savings goal “{name}”: progress cannot be measured – the savings rate does not flow into a savings account, it is only debited. Assign a savings account to the goal, then every instalment counts towards progress.
finance.advisor.target_portfolio: Target portfolio: {value} of {target} ({gap} missing to the target range).
finance.advisor.dq_null_rate: {n} foreign currency(ies) without an exchange rate (amounts not yet converted to EUR);
finance.advisor.digest_no_plan: No financial plan has been published yet – the check only shows the key figures.
finance.advisor.digest_cashflow: Monthly cashflow: income {income} · spending {consumption} · everyday (estimated) {everyday} · repayment {principal} → free {free} · saving {saving} → account {account_change}
finance.advisor.digest_goal_line_unmeasu: - {name}: progress not measurable (target {target}, no savings account assigned)
finance.advisor.digest_reserve_heading: Reserve breakdown (where the goal money sits):
finance.advisor.digest_price_stale: (Note: price data is stale or missing – allocation may be inaccurate.)
finance.advisor.digest_p2p: (Note: P2P (e.g. Bondora) counts at face value in the target portfolio – market value/default risk not considered.)
finance.advisor.target_portfolio_fx_gap: Note: this value is incomplete because an exchange rate is missing.
finance.advisor.digest_alloc_outside: (Outside the plan, not compared: {value} – e.g. cash without a cash block or positions without a matching block.)
finance.advisor.digest_real_estate_value: (Note: a property with a loan has no value recorded – net worth is computed without this property and without its loan.)
finance.hitl.void_bank_statement: Take back the last bank statement – please check:
finance.note.statement_drift: Before this period the balance in the system did not match the statement. The difference is booked as a separate correction on the day before.
finance.label.statement_missing: Not on the statement (will be skipped)
finance.label.statement_not_booked: Not booked automatically (counts toward the rest)
finance.tpl.statement_interest_correctio: Interest per statement {lines}, estimated so far {booked}
finance.note.statement_interest_skips: {count} still open interest periods are settled by this (the statement shows the real interest).
finance.label.statement_legacy_returns: Returns from old loans (as one total)
finance.note.statement_pool_unassigned: {count} payment(s) to or from a provider's shared account could not be assigned to an account and stay in the rest. For deposits, store the reference as the provider account's account number; for payouts, set its settlement account.
finance.note.statement_no_settlement: Deposits and withdrawals stay in the rest: no settlement account is set for this account (the account the provider pays out to).
finance.note.statement_lump: Everything else on the statement is not stored line by line but booked as one total. Afterwards the balance matches the statement.
finance.note.statement_void: The balance goes back to where it was before this statement. You can then send the statement again.
finance.note.statement_after_period: {amount} of it was only booked after {date} – that counts towards the next monthly check.
finance.note.statement_export_gap: {amount} of it is not in the export yet – usually pending card payments that the app already deducts. They count towards the rest this time and even out with the next export.
finance.note.statement_export_gap_settle: The export shows {amount} more spending than the app balance – usually card payments that were still pending last time and are already in the last rest. The balance is still correct.
finance.note.statement_export_starts_lat: The export may not reach back to the confirmed balance of {date}. If transactions in between are missing, {amount} of it ends up in the rest – better cancel and export a longer period (e.g. this year and last year).
finance.note.iban_learned_other: The IBAN {iban} will be saved for the account “{account}” (recognised from a transfer). The monthly check will then book such transfers as transfers. If that is wrong, please cancel.
finance.note.iban_removed: The stored account number (IBAN) of this account will be removed.
finance.note.emergency_target_months: Target: {months} months of expenses at {monthly} (fixed payments and loan instalments {fixed} + estimated everyday spending {everyday}) = {target}
finance.note.emergency_target_unknown: Target: {months} months of expenses – the amount is known once regular payments or a bank statement are recorded.
finance.note.emergency_covered: Earmarked as emergency reserve so far: {covered}
finance.note.min_balance_default: The buffer of this account goes back to the household default.
finance.note.iban_learn_conflict: The IBAN {iban} and another IBAN from this statement both fit the account “{account}”. I saved neither. Tell me which IBAN belongs to that account.
finance.note.iban_learn_ambiguous: A transfer with the IBAN {iban} fits several of your accounts ({accounts}), so it stays in the rest. Tell me which account the IBAN belongs to and I will add it.
finance.label.statement_pending_settled: Evens out payments pending at the last monthly check
finance.label.statement_trades_blocked: Securities that are not booked automatically (count towards the rest)
finance.tpl.statement_trade_covered_by_t: is part of the position takeover (take over the individual purchases first)
finance.tpl.statement_trade_oversell: more units sold than held in the depot
finance.label.statement_export_unknown: Unknown rows in the export (count towards the rest)
finance.hitl.replace_takeover_lots: Take over individual purchases ({account}) – please check:
finance.tpl.lots_replaced_row: {name}: {count} individual purchases instead of one takeover, {shares} units, cost {avg_before} → {avg}
finance.note.lots_cash_after_cut: Purchases after {date} are not yet included in the confirmed balance of {account}. They are booked as real purchases and reduce the balance.
finance.note.lots_mismatch: {name}: the purchases in the export differ from the takeover by {difference} units – nothing is changed here.
finance.note.lots_not_bookable: {name}: one purchase in the export is too small to book – nothing is changed here.
finance.dialog.monthly_check_line_file: • {name} (balance confirmed up to: {date}) – via file: create the transaction export (this year) in the app and send the file here; if the file shows no closing balance, also tell me the balance the app shows right now
finance.cron.reconcile_accounts.label: Monthly check (bank statements)
finance.cron.reconcile_accounts.on_messa: Monthly check on: on the 3rd and 17th I remind you about missing bank statements.
finance.cron.reconcile_accounts.off_mess: Monthly check off: I will no longer remind you about bank statements.
finance.cron.remind_pension_statement.on: Pension check on: when a pension statement is older than a year, I remind you.
finance.cron.remind_pension_statement.of: Pension check off: I will no longer remind you about pension statements.
finance.cron.remind_missing_prices.label: Price check (missing security prices)
finance.cron.remind_missing_prices.on_me: Price check on: if a depot position has no price, I will let you know – with a checked suggestion where possible.
finance.cron.remind_missing_prices.off_m: Price check off: I will no longer report missing security prices.
finance.cron.remind_interest.label: Book interest credits
finance.cron.remind_interest.on_message: Interest reminder on: when an interest credit is due, I ask whether to book it.
finance.cron.remind_interest.off_message: Interest reminder off: you now book interest credits yourself, or they come in with the bank statement.
finance.note.funding_ok: Afterwards {account} is covered – {in} in, {out} out per month.
finance.note.funding_ok_drain: Afterwards {account} is covered – it draws down {drain} per month, lowest balance {min} on {date}.
finance.note.funding_until: Afterwards the money on {account} lasts until {date} – {in} in, {out} out per month.
finance.note.funding_gap: Afterwards {account} runs short from {date} – {in} in, {out} out per month.
finance.note.funding_timing: Afterwards the money reaches {account} too late: it runs short from {date}, lowest balance {min} on {min_date}. In and out are equal, but the incoming money arrives after the debit.
finance.note.funding_until_date: Afterwards the money on {account} lasts until {date}.
finance.note.recurring_iban_key: From now on this payment is recognised by the IBAN {iban}, even when the amount varies. If it is wrong, please cancel.
